row.proto: void Ne_AnimPacketL1_Sample(void *packet, void *binding, float time, void *out)
row.notes: Slot +0x18 (sample) of the NeAnimPacket_L1 vtable 0x1458a18f0 and its only reference (cell 0x1458a1908); the packet factory 0x1443b5880 installs that vtable. Arguments as Ne_AnimPacketB1_Sample; the time stays in xmm2. Its per-track sampling is inline: vucomiss xmm4,xmm2 at 0x143a3a604, vcvttss2si ebp at 0x143a3a614, movzx edi,word [rdi+rbx*2] at 0x143a3a678. A track of 3 or more keys compares the time only with its first key (vucomiss; jae, not taken when unordered), turns (time - first key) * rate into a bucket index with vcvttss2si, passes the signed cmp/jle against the bucket count and reads the bucket table at that index: a time that is not a number or plus infinity gives 0x80000000 and reads 4 GB below the table. The lowest float takes the first-key exit (segment 0 at weight 0); a 2-key track clamps it to weight 0 with vmaxss; a 1-key track ignores the time. Core's anim packet time guard wraps it.

verify.notes: gh:anim-packet-time-blind Blind re-derivation on d873a1c8. Factory jump table 0x145a969c8: type 0 stores the vtable 0x1458a18f0 (lea at 0x1443b62c8; NeAnimPacket_L1 sits just before it, and it is the float L1, unlike type 7 0x1458a1980, which reads int16 keys). Its slot +0x10 goes through 0x143a3a470 to 0x1520581c0, which hands 0x143a38180 the label NeAnimPacket_L1_FP16. That label is cosmetic, but it does not match the class. The vtable has 11 slots, so no +0x58, and only +0x18 reads a float register. Slot +0x18 = 0x143a3a520 (.pdata to 0x143a3a705), referenced only by the cell 0x1458a1908; the rel32-looking bytes at 0x143231e92 sit inside a mov word instruction and are not a call. rcx = packet, rdx = binding slot, xmm2 = time (never written; xmm1 and xmm3 are overwritten at 0x143a3a576/0x143a3a57a), r9 = output. For 3+ keys, vucomiss xmm4,xmm2 at 0x143a3a604; jae 0x143a3a651 is not taken when unordered. vcvttss2si ebp at 0x143a3a614; signed cmp r12d,ebp; jle at 0x143a3a626; movsxd rbx,ebp and movzx edi,word [rdi+rbx*2] at 0x143a3a678. -FLT_MAX takes the jae (segment 0, weight 0, value = key 0). 2-key: vmaxss with 0 gives weight 0 at segment 0, no time index; 1-key ignores the time. Large finite times with (time-first)*rate >= 2^31 are not covered by a non-finite-only guard. Same text and rip constants at Steam 26566308 0x143a3caf0 (.tls$, vtable 0x1458a3a60 +0x18), EA 1.0.141 0x143a27540 (.rdata, vtable 0x1459b2b30), EA 1.0.145 0x143a29b10 (.arch, vtable 0x1459b5c80). The 14-byte prologue pattern hits once in the whole file of all four, at the hints 0x3a3a520/0x3a3caf0/0x3a27540/0x3a29b10.
